ocrRegions.text: 食べちゃってあんたも早くほれ
行ってくるよ母さ～ん俺もバタバタと……どうしたんだ
ocrRegions.translatedText: I'm off, Mom! I'm rushing around too... What's wrong?

ocrRegions.text: ないか…はは……に…似合ってるじゃ
ocrRegions.translatedText: It… it looks good on you, haha…

ocrRegions.text: お仕事頑張ってね～行ってらっしゃ～い
ocrRegions.translatedText: Good luck at work! See you later!

ocrRegions.text: そ…それが例の…あ…あ…あぁ…
ocrRegions.translatedText: S-so that's the one you mentioned... Ah... ah... oh...

ocrRegions.text: 高いなぁ…なんて…布地のわりにさ…最近の制服は…い…いやぁ…
ocrRegions.translatedText: Must’ve cost a lot… I mean, for that much fabric… Uniforms these days… N-no, never mind…

ocrRegions.text: ナイスそっくりだ……母さんの若いころに
ocrRegions.translatedText: Wow… you look just like your mother did when she was young.
